title: The Custom Domain Headache: How to Automate SSL for Your Clients Without Killing Your Margin
body:
¿Are your clients demanding to use their own custom domains on your platform, but manual setup is draining your support hours?

For a small agency building websites, a local directory, or a micro-SaaS founder, offering a "use your own domain" feature is vital to retain clients. However, every time a user tries to point their domain, the nightmare begins: guiding them through DNS records, manually generating SSL certificates, configuring the server, and praying an update won't crash everyone else's site. You are wasting entire mornings acting as a systems technician instead of growing your business.

The Enterprise Platform Trap

Many entrepreneurs try to fix this by hiring external routing services or premium tools that promise white-label SSL automation. But they soon discover the harsh reality: they drag you into contracts costing hundreds of dollars a month or limit your domain count unless you pay up. For a freelancer or a small business, paying such a high monthly toll before validating real business volume is financial suicide. Outsourcing infrastructure without control turns your already tight margin into a fixed-cost trap.

Our Solution: Cloud API for Automated Routing

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we design and integrate a custom Serverless Cloud API that manages SSL certificate provisioning and reverse proxy routing 100% automatically at a near-zero residual cost.

  1. Real-time DNS validation: The API checks via automated endpoints if the client has correctly pointed their A or CNAME records before launching the process.
  2. Serverless SSL generation: We automate the isolation of SSL certificate requests and renewals through Let's Encrypt, guaranteeing secure connections instantly.
  3. Perimeter traffic isolation: We implement a dynamic reverse proxy in the cloud that routes requests without single-domain failures ever affecting the main server.
  4. Programmatic control panel: Your platform communicates with our API via webhooks to instantly activate, pause, or remove domains based on subscription status.

The Real Impact on Business Operations

  • 90% cost savings: You eliminate third-party service subscriptions, paying only cents per request on your own cloud infrastructure.
  • Automated technical support: You reduce customer support tickets regarding misconfigured domains to zero, thanks to the API's automated guidance system.
  • Uncapped scalability: You can onboard thousands of custom domains for your clients without worrying about slowing down your hosting or degrading user experience.
